==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Enjoyed playing [[wikipedia:Dishonored|Dishonored]].
* Is the first Welsh player to have played a game at the [[World Championship]], reaching the quarterfinals of [[Worlds 2017]] with [[Misfits (European Team)|Misfits]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* EU 1st All Pro Team x2 (2020 Summer, 2020 Spring)
* EU 2nd All Pro Team x1 (2019 Summer)
* EU 3rd All Pro Team x1 (2019 Spring)
* NA 1st All Pro Team x1 (2021 Spring)
